opener: Halt, citizens! I am Mayor Gourdsworth. What fine costumes.
The porch court is in session. Step forward and be licensed.
Welcome to Pumpkinville. Papers, please — ah, your costume will do.
stamp: By the power of this porch, licensed to collect sweets. Stamp!
Form 31-B approved. Collect sweets. Next citizen.
Official pumpkin seal applied. Candy awaits.
shy: No speech required. I stamp you anyway. Candy is that way.
Silence is accepted as consent to sweets. Licensed. Off you go.
crowd: A formidable party! Group license approved. Strike a pose. Candy awaits.
Too many voices for one quill. Group stamp. Next.
fallback: I only handle pumpkin civic affairs. Have a sweet. Stamp.
The paperwork is jammed. Take candy while I sort the gourds.
distress: That's a big feeling. Tell a grown-up you came with.
goodnight: The mayor's office is closed. Goodnight, citizens.
